title: Oozing Rich Ethiopian Water Chestnut Flatbread
description: A low‑fat, gooey injera‑style flatbread infused with water chestnut puree for a comforting sick‑day treat.
instructions: In a bowl mix flour, yeast, sugar, and salt.
In a separate jug whisk water, vegetable broth, and egg white until frothy.
Pour the liquid mixture into the dry ingredients and stir until a smooth batter forms, then fold in the water chestnut puree to emulsify.
Cover the batter and let it rise at room temperature for 60 minutes until doubled.
Preheat a nonstick skillet over medium heat and spray lightly with cooking spray.
Ladle a thin layer of batter onto the skillet, tilting to spread evenly.
Cook 3 minutes until bubbles appear and edges lift, then flip and cook another 2 minutes.
Transfer to a plate and serve warm, optionally sprinkling a pinch of salt.
